name: keyline
description: Design with Claude: layouts, ads and social posts rendered to PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, APNG, GIF and video at every size.
long_description: keyline is a design engine Claude drives over MCP. Claude builds a scene of text, images, shapes and layout; keyline measures it (text that doesn't fit, layers cut off, low contrast), so Claude fixes problems before rendering, and renders every size you ask for. No browser; one native binary.

folders.title: Folders keyline may read
folders.description: Claude can add images and templates from these folders by path, without passing their bytes through the chat.

stills_only.title: Stills only
stills_only.description: Leave animation and video out of the tools: fewer tokens per message.
